comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record calibrates a mounted tool tip by touching one point from four distinct angles.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses bimanual long-part handling, compliant latch insertion, telescoping, and screw driving; record uses single-point contact maintenance with controlled tool-axis variation and stillness.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained hardware at the intended rack unit; record credits four one-second contact poses with force, position, lean, and inter-pose angular separation limits.
comparison.reason: Calibration through repeated constrained contact is meaningfully different from mechanical mounting. Candidate contact-force, pose, and stillness tolerances are incompletely numeric.
